tools.description: Evaluate finite double-precision arithmetic: + - * / % ^, parentheses, pi, e; abs, sqrt, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, ln, log/log10, exp, floor, ceil, round, min(a,b), max(a,b), pow(a,b). Trigonometric angles are radians; ^ is right-associative. Maximum 4096 input bytes and 64 active recursive parsing levels. Returns an answer and numeric value, or an error code, message, and zero-based byte offset.
tools.short_description: Evaluate arithmetic expressions with constants and mathematical functions
